acceptance.accepted_history_rule: Only the event exactly anchored by CURRENT.latest_event commit+path+digest is accepted history.
acceptance.duplicate_rule: Existing deterministic claim path is DUPLICATE; do not replace claim, outbox, event, or CURRENT.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Event-first; after event readback refetch CURRENT and require exact equality to preflight v77/blob 8f359fe94146395d79397bb70fd19b0f5662696d/stored digest b8ef610cc8c84edc25470d919fb14e7917a2032d80431b9d398190e47b89571d/latest_event commit+path+digest. Only then replace CURRENT once with the original exact prior blob SHA and read back.
acceptance.slack_gate: Post only after exact v78 readback anchors this event and the read-back CURRENT digest recomputes.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: The second-read gate is sequential and one local carrier performs both reads. It narrows the window between event creation and CURRENT update but does not eliminate a race after the second read. Git rejects a changed file blob on this branch when the supplied SHA is stale, but does not provide cross-file atomicity, database isolation or uniqueness, linearizability, exactly-once execution, force-push safety, cross-branch exclusion, or Slack atomicity.

probe.controlled_factor: Only the CURRENT pointer update pattern changes; event canonicalization, immutable chain, idempotency claim, outbox, exact version/blob precondition, and Slack gate stay fixed.
probe.hypothesis: A second branch read immediately after immutable event readback should reject drift before attempting the single-file CURRENT replacement.
probe.name: CURRENT_SECOND_READ_STABILITY_GATE_V1

negative_control.mutation: Simulated second read changed version to 78 and declared projection digest to 64 zeroes while the preflight snapshot stayed v77.

probe.strongest_falsifier: Second read differs yet update is attempted; unchanged second read fails; stale prior blob is accepted; or final readback fails digest or event-anchor checks.

canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete artifacts. If v78 is invalid, append a compensating transition from the then-current exact version.
